title: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
title_zh: SWE-Shift：在演化工作区中评估编程智能体

paragraphs.en: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级编程基准测试在很大程度上假设任务和环境在整个执行过程中保持不变。 在软件开发中，代码、依赖、运行时状态和需求可能会在智能体仍在工作时发生变化。 我们提出 SWE-Shift，一个用于评估智能体在此类执行中途变化下表现的编程基准。 从同一份保存的历史和工作区出发，Clean（干净）延续在不干预的情况下继续进行，而与之匹配的 Shifted（变更）延续则接收一个与任务相关的更新。 成功需要完成当前任务、保留仍然有效的工作，并满足适用的状态与证据检查。 该基准包含 120 个场景，涵盖 12 个变更族，每个场景在九个预定干预位置上进行评估。 我们评估了 17 个编程智能体系统，它们的 Shifted 成功率均低于 Clean 成功率。 GPT-6 Astra 从 67.35% 降至 24.79%，配对成功率为 20.34%。 在所有系统上，工具/会话变更和过期证据的配对成功率均为零。 后期位置的配对成功率在某些系统上更低，在另一些系统上更高。 这些结果表明，在未变更任务上的成功，可能与更新后未能保留工作、恢复状态或刷新证据的情况并存。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level benchmarks such as SWE-bench [ 13 ] have made it possible to evaluate coding agents on realistic software engineering tasks rather than isolated code generation. An agent must understand an issue, navigate a repository, modify executable code, and satisfy tests. Yet these benchmarks largely assume that once execution begins, the task and its environment remain unchanged. Real software development is less static. Code may be edited, dependencies may change, runtime state may evolve, and requirements or available information may be updated while an agent is still working.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 SWE-bench [ 13 ] 之类的仓库级基准测试，使得在真实的软件工程任务而非孤立的代码生成上评估智能体成为可能。 智能体必须理解问题、浏览仓库、修改可执行的代码，并通过测试。 然而这些基准测试大多假设，一旦执行开始，任务及其环境便保持不变。 真实的软件开发并非如此静态。 在智能体仍在工作时，代码可能被编辑、依赖可能变化、运行时状态可能演进，需求或可用信息也可能被更新。

paragraphs.en: This raises a different reliability question:
paragraphs.zh: 这引出了另一个可靠性问题：

paragraphs.en: Can a coding agent continue to succeed when task-relevant changes occur during execution?
paragraphs.zh: 当代码智能体在执行过程中遇到与任务相关的变化时，它还能继续取得成功吗？

paragraphs.en: This question is not answered by evaluating agents on changed tasks alone. If an agent fails after a change, we do not know whether it was unable to solve the underlying task in the first place or whether the change disrupted an execution that would otherwise have succeeded. A useful evaluation must therefore separate these two sources of failure.
paragraphs.zh: 仅通过在发生变化的任务上评估智能体，无法回答这个问题。 如果智能体在发生变化后失败，我们无法判断它是一开始就无法解决底层任务，还是该变化破坏了原本本可成功的执行过程。 因此，一个有用的评估必须区分这两种失败来源。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Shift, which addresses this problem through matched Clean and Shifted continuations (Figure 2 ). The agent first works on the task normally. At an intermediate point, we save its execution state and continue from the same prefix in two ways: the Clean continuation proceeds without a change, while the Shifted continuation introduces a task-relevant change. Because the two continuations share the same prior actions, workspace, and observable history, Clean provides a matched baseline for whether the agent can succeed from that state, while Shifted tests whether that success survives the change.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SWE-Shift，它通过匹配的 Clean（干净）延续与 Shifted（偏移）延续来解决这一问题（图 2）。 智能体首先照常执行任务。 在某个中间节点，我们保存其执行状态，并从相同前缀以两种方式继续：Clean 延续在不做任何改变的情况下继续，而 Shifted 延续则引入一个与任务相关的改变。 由于这两种延续共享相同的先前动作、工作区和可观察历史，Clean 为智能体能否从该状态取得成功提供了匹配的基线，而 Shifted 则检验这一成功在改变之后是否仍然成立。

paragraphs.en: Constructing such an evaluation also requires the changes themselves to be meaningful. A change should matter to the task, but it should not make the task impossible. SWE-Shift therefore includes scenarios in which ignoring the change can invalidate an otherwise successful continuation, while a correct continuation remains possible after the change. We also introduce each change at multiple points during execution, rather than tying the benchmark to a single moment in the agent’s trajectory. Finally, success is judged against the requirements that apply after the update, including preservation and evidence requirements that the original task tests may not cover.
paragraphs.zh: 构建这样的评估还要求变更本身是有意义的。 变更应当与任务相关，但不应使任务变得不可能完成。 因此，SWE-Shift 包含这样一些场景：忽略变更会使原本成功的延续失效，而变更之后正确的延续仍然是可能的。 我们还在执行过程中的多个时点引入变更，而不是将基准绑定到智能体轨迹中的单一时刻。 最后，成功与否是根据更新之后适用的要求来判定的，包括原始任务测试可能未涵盖的保留要求和证据要求。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation of current coding agents reveals a substantial gap between success in unchanged and changing environments. As shown in Figure 1 , all 17 evaluated coding-agent systems have lower observed success after the intervention. GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest Clean success, drops from 67.35% on Clean continuations to 24.79% on Shifted continuations. The size of the gap also varies across change families and intervention positions, suggesting that robustness to mid-execution change captures behavior that static task success alone does not reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对当前编程智能体的评估显示，在未变化环境和变化环境中的成功率之间存在巨大差距。 如图1所示，全部17个被评估的编程智能体系统在干预之后的观测成功率都有所下降。 Clean成功率最高的GPT-6 Astra，从Clean续写上的67.35%下降到Shifted续写上的24.79%。 差距的大小在不同变化类别和干预位置之间也存在差异，这表明对执行中途变化的鲁棒性捕捉到了仅凭静态任务成功率无法揭示的行为。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify robustness to mid-execution change as an evaluation target beyond static task success, distinguishing failures on the underlying task from losses of successful continuations after a task-relevant change.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将对执行中途变更的鲁棒性识别为超越静态任务成功的一个评估目标，从而将底层任务的失败与任务相关变更后成功延续性的丧失区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Shift, a matched-continuation benchmark with 120 scenarios across 12 change families and nine intervention positions, enabling controlled comparison of Clean and Shifted executions from the same intermediate agent state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-Shift，这是一个匹配延续基准，包含 12 个变更类别和九个干预位置上的 120 个场景，支持从同一中间智能体状态出发，对 Clean 与 Shifted 执行进行受控比较。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems and find a substantial gap between Clean and Shifted success, with failures varying across change families and intervention positions. Recorded trajectories and diagnostic controls further characterize these failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 17 个编码智能体系统，发现 Clean 与 Shifted 成功率之间存在巨大差距，且失败情况因变更家族和干预位置的不同而各异。 录制的轨迹和诊断性控制实验进一步刻画了这些失败的特征。

paragraphs.en: Repository benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate issue resolution but normally keep the task and environment fixed during execution [ 13 ] . Related dynamic coding evaluations study different kinds of change: SWE-Touch injects validated user edits during execution, SyncMind begins recovery from repository inconsistencies, SWE-INTERACT reveals or revises requirements through dialogue, and SpecPath varies specification history before implementation [ 30 , 10 , 28 , 32 ] . ToolSandbox contributes state dependencies, milestone/Minefield trajectory evaluation, while Gaia2 adds independently evolving asynchronous events and action-level write verification [ 16 , 8 ] . Table 1 compares these evaluation designs. “Mid-episode” denotes an external intervention after execution begins. “Fresh evidence” means that completion claims are checked against the current state. SWE-Shift combines three controls: matched continuations from the same recorded prefix, changes to multiple parts of the task environment, and checks that reject the loss of still-valid behavior even when the original task tests pass. Table 7 in Appendix E provides a detailed comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 SWE-bench 之类的仓库基准评估问题解决能力，但通常在执行过程中保持任务和环境固定 [ 13 ] 。 相关的动态编码评估研究了不同类型的变化：SWE-Touch 在执行过程中注入经过验证的用户编辑，SyncMind 从仓库不一致状态开始恢复，SWE-INTERACT 通过对话揭示或修订需求，而 SpecPath 在实现之前改变规范历史 [ 30 , 10 , 28 , 32 ] 。 ToolSandbox 贡献了状态依赖和里程碑/Minefield 轨迹评估，而 Gaia2 增加了独立演化的异步事件和动作级写入验证 [ 16 , 8 ] 。 表 1 比较了这些评估设计。「Mid-episode（执行中）」指执行开始后的外部干预。「Fresh evidence（新鲜证据）」指完成声明需对照当前状态进行核查。 SWE-Shift 结合了三项控制：来自同一记录前缀的匹配续接、对任务环境多个部分的更改，以及即使原始任务测试通过也会拒绝丢失仍然有效行为的检查。 附录 E 中的表 7 提供了详细比较。

paragraphs.en: We first describe how task-relevant changes are designed (Section 3.1 ). We then explain how matched continuations and intervention timing support controlled comparisons (Section 3.2 ). Finally, we define the success criteria and metrics used to evaluate these continuations (Section 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: To evaluate adaptation, these changes must challenge the agent without making successful completion impossible. We therefore require each change to be both relevant and recoverable . Relevance means that ignoring the change can invalidate an otherwise successful continuation. Recoverability means that, after the change, at least one valid way to complete the task remains available through the agent-accessible tools. Together, these requirements exclude changes that do not matter to the task and changes that make the task unsolvable.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估适应能力，这些变更必须对智能体构成挑战，同时又不能使成功完成任务变得不可能。 因此，我们要求每一项变更都必须既具有相关性，又具备可恢复性。 相关性意味着忽视该变更可能会使原本可以成功的执行过程失效。 可恢复性意味着变更之后，仍然至少存在一种通过智能体可访问的工具完成任务的有效方式。 这两项要求合在一起，排除了对任务无关紧要的变更以及使任务无解的变更。

paragraphs.en: To turn such a change into an executable evaluation scenario, we specify four elements: the initial repository task, an authorized mid-execution change, a way for the agent to encounter or discover that change, and executable checks for a correct continuation. These checks reflect the requirements that apply after the update: some original requirements remain in force, while others may be added or withdrawn. A correct continuation must satisfy the current requirements while preserving work and effects that remain valid.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将这样的变更转化为可执行的评估场景，我们指定了四个要素：初始仓库任务、一次授权的执行中途变更、智能体遇到或发现该变更的方式，以及用于验证正确续作的可用检查项。 这些检查项反映了更新后适用的要求：部分原有要求仍然有效，而另一些要求可能被新增或撤销。 正确的续作必须满足当前的要求，同时保留仍然有效的工作成果与效果。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Shift compares continuations with and without a mid-execution change from the same prior execution ( Figure 2 ). For each system, scenario, and intervention position, the agent first executes a single shared prefix. At the scheduled checkpoint, the runner saves the agent-visible history, workspace, controller state, available tools, system settings, and execution counters. The saved state is then restored twice to create a matched pair of continuations.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-Shift 将来自同一次先前执行的中途变更前后的延续进行对比（图 2）。 对于每个系统、场景和干预位置，智能体首先执行一个共享的前缀。 在预定的检查点，运行器保存智能体可见的历史记录、工作区、控制器状态、可用工具、系统设置和执行计数器。 保存的状态随后被恢复两次，以创建一组匹配的延续。

paragraphs.en: In the Clean continuation, execution proceeds without the scenario’s task-relevant update. In the Shifted continuation, the authorized update is applied at the fork. Up to that point, the two continuations have the same recorded execution history and workspace state. Only after the intervention can their observations and actions diverge. This differs from comparing independently generated runs, where differences before the change may already affect the outcome. The Clean continuation therefore provides a matched baseline for whether the agent can complete the task from that particular intermediate state, while the Shifted continuation tests whether that success survives the change.
paragraphs.zh: 在「干净延续」中，执行继续进行，但不包含该场景中与任务相关的更新。 在「偏移延续」中，授权的更新在分叉点被应用。 在此之前，两个延续具有相同的记录执行历史和工作区状态。 只有在该干预之后，二者的观察和动作才可能出现分歧。 这不同于比较独立生成的运行，因为在那样的比较中，变更之前的差异可能已经影响了结果。 因此，「干净延续」提供了一个匹配的基线，用于检验智能体能否从该特定中间状态完成任务；而「偏移延续」则检验该成功能否经受住这一变更。

paragraphs.en: The update is introduced through the scenario’s declared interface. Depending on the case, the agent may encounter it as a workspace change, a delivered message, a changed tool or session response, or new information returned by an allowed state query. The evaluator may use additional held-out checks to determine correctness, but these checks do not provide additional information to the agent. Thus, the paired comparison changes the task-relevant conditions after the fork while keeping the observable pre-intervention execution fixed.

paragraphs.en: A single intervention point could make the evaluation depend strongly on when the change happens to occur. SWE-Shift therefore evaluates every scenario at nine progressively later intervention positions, denoted T10–T90. These positions are constructed from an eligible prefix of a reference solution, ending before the first action whose correctness depends on the update. The construction procedure provides nine distinct intervention anchors spanning 10%–90% of the eligible reference progress for every admitted scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 单一的干预点可能使评估强烈依赖于变更恰好发生的时间。 因此，SWE-Shift 在九个逐渐靠后的干预位置上评估每个场景，这些位置记为 T10–T90。 这些位置由参考解的一个合格前缀构成，该前缀在第一个其正确性依赖于更新的动作之前结束。 该构建过程为每个被采纳的场景提供了九个不同的干预锚点，覆盖合格参考进度的 10%–90%。

paragraphs.en: During model evaluation, the intervention position determines how many agent actions are executed before the fork. The evaluated agent is not required to follow the reference trajectory used to construct the schedule. Consequently, T10–T90 represent progressively later scheduled positions , rather than normalized semantic progress through the task. Different systems may therefore have reached different workspace states when the same nominal intervention position is triggered. If an agent terminates before the scheduled intervention or changes the state in a way that affects whether the update can still be applied, the cell retains its assigned intervention position and is handled by the benchmark’s outcome protocol without rescheduling.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型评估期间，干预位置决定了在分叉之前执行多少个智能体动作。 被评估的智能体不要求遵循用于构建时间表的参考轨迹。 因此，T10–T90 表示逐渐靠后的计划位置，而不是任务中归一化的语义进度。 因此，当触发相同的名义干预位置时，不同系统可能已处于不同的工作区状态。 如果某个智能体在计划干预之前终止，或以影响更新是否仍可应用的方式改变了状态，则该单元格保留其被分配的干预位置，并由基准测试的结果协议处理，而不会重新调度。

paragraphs.en: A continuation is counted as successful only if it satisfies every check that applies under the conditions in which it ends. For the Clean continuation, these are the original task and environment conditions. For the Shifted continuation, they are the conditions after the update. The original task tests are therefore only one part of the evaluation. Depending on the scenario, success may additionally require preserving still-valid behavior, following the current goal or interface, avoiding prohibited effects, or obtaining evidence that is valid for the current state. The implementation groups these requirements into task, preservation, recovery, authority, effect, evidence, budget, and terminal-integrity checks. The criterion is conjunctive: failing any applicable check makes the continuation unsuccessful. Table 6 summarizes the required evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当续写满足在其结束条件下适用的每一项检查时，才将其计为成功。 对于干净（Clean）续写，这些检查是原始任务与环境条件。 对于偏移（Shifted）续写，这些检查是更新之后的条件。 因此，原始任务测试只是评估的一部分。 视场景而定，成功可能还要求保留仍然有效的行为、遵循当前目标或接口、避免被禁止的效果，或获取对当前状态有效的证据。 实现将这些要求归入任务、保留、恢复、权限、效果、证据、预算和终止完整性检查。 该标准是合取式的：未通过任何适用的检查都会使续写不成功。 表 6 总结了所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments ask whether coding capability survives a workspace change (RQ1), which changes expose shared or system-specific weaknesses (RQ2), whether their timing matters (RQ3), and what a failed continuation can hide from ordinary task tests (RQ4). paragraphs.en: Existing repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume fixed tasks and environments, leaving agents’ ability to handle mid-execution changes insufficiently tested. We introduced SWE-Shift to address this gap through task-relevant, recoverable interventions and matched Clean and Shifted continuations from the same saved execution state. Its success criteria jointly assess task completion, preservation of valid work, recovery, and evidence validity. Evaluation across 17 coding-agent systems shows that success under unchanged conditions often does not survive an update. Family-level and trajectory analyses further reveal recurring failures in state recovery, preservation, and evidence use that original task tests can miss. SWE-Shift provides a common testbed for measuring robustness to change, diagnosing these failures, and assessing whether new methods improve agents’ ability to continue working reliably in evolving software environments.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的仓库级编程基准测试大多假设任务和环境是固定的，导致对智能体应对执行中途变化的能力测试不足。 我们推出了 SWE-Shift，通过与任务相关、可恢复的干预，以及来自同一保存执行状态的匹配的 Clean 与 Shifted 续跑，来填补这一空白。 其成功标准综合评估任务完成度、有效工作的保留、恢复情况以及证据的有效性。 对 17 个编程智能体系统的评估表明，在条件不变时取得的成功往往无法经受住一次更新。 家族层面与轨迹层面的分析进一步揭示了状态恢复、保留和证据使用方面反复出现的失败，而这些失败是原始任务测试可能遗漏的。 SWE-Shift 提供了一个统一的测试平台，用于衡量对变化的鲁棒性、诊断这些失败，并评估新方法能否提升智能体在不断演化的软件环境中持续可靠工作的能力。

paragraphs.en: A scenario specifies a repository task, a task-relevant change, how the agent can discover that change, and checks for a correct continuation. The change may affect repository files, runtime or session state, external effects, requirements, or the evidence available to the agent. After the change, some requirements remain, some are added, and some may be withdrawn. A correct continuation must satisfy the current requirements while preserving work and effects that are still valid.
paragraphs.zh: 场景规定了一个仓库任务、一项与任务相关的变更、智能体如何发现该变更，以及针对正确后续工作的检查。 该变更可能影响仓库文件、运行时或会话状态、外部效果、需求，或智能体可获得的证据。 变更之后，一些需求仍然保留，一些被新增，还有一些可能被撤回。 正确的后续工作必须满足当前需求，同时保留仍然有效的工作和效果。

paragraphs.en: The suite covers ten scenarios in each of 12 change families ( Figure 3 ). F01–F07 concern code, collaborators, runtime, sessions, and effects; F08–F10 separate disclosure, corrective feedback, and goal revision; F11–F12 separate stale from misbound evidence. The 120 scenarios comprise an initial 24-case set and a 96-case expansion, sharing 23 root snapshots and 39 family–archetype–root clusters. The initial 24 cases were constructed and audited with GPT-5.6 Sol in the Codex app at xhigh reasoning; their full trajectories support the qualitative analysis in Appendix G . Roots can occur across families, and equal family weights provide controlled coverage of the change families.
paragraphs.zh: 该套件覆盖12个变更族中每个族下的十个场景（图3）。 F01–F07涉及代码、协作者、运行时、会话与效果；F08–F10将披露、纠错反馈与目标修订区分开；F11–F12将陈旧证据与错误绑定证据区分开。 这120个场景由最初的24个案例集和96个案例的扩展集组成，共享23个根快照和39个族–原型–根聚类。 最初的24个案例是在Codex应用中使用GPT-5.6 Sol以xhigh推理构建并审核的；其完整轨迹支持附录G中的定性分析。 根可以跨族出现，相等的族权重可对变更族提供受控覆盖。

paragraphs.en: For a system and checkpoint, the runner executes one prefix and saves the workspace, controller state, available tools, and the agent’s recorded history, system settings, and counters. Both continuations resume from this saved state. Clean continues without a relevant update; Shifted applies the scenario’s update. Their subsequent observations and actions may differ.

paragraphs.en: The nine checkpoints cover early through late reference progress, from 10% to 90% of the eligible action sequence. paragraphs.en: SWE-bench establishes executable repository-level issue resolution [ 13 ] ; SWE-agent demonstrates that the agent–computer interface changes how effectively a model can navigate, edit, and test a repository [ 35 ] . SWE-Touch is the closest intervention study: it injects validated task-conflicting Counter-Edits during execution, includes a helpful non-solving Co-Edit control, and studies repeated edits and relative schedules on longer tasks [ 30 ] . SyncMind uses repository histories to construct caller/callee inconsistencies and evaluates autonomous and collaborative recovery [ 10 ] . SWE-Shift forks continuations from the same recorded history and checks the requirements that remain in force after an authorized update. An update may need to be retained even when removing it would still pass the original issue’s tests. Table 7 compares these designs at the level of the manipulated object, history control, and outcome.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 建立了可执行的仓库级问题解决基准 [ 13 ]；SWE-agent 证明了智能体-计算机接口会改变模型浏览、编辑和测试仓库的有效程度 [ 35 ]。 SWE-Touch 是最接近的干预性研究：它在执行过程中注入经过验证的、与任务冲突的反向编辑（Counter-Edits），包含一个有帮助但不解决问题的协同编辑（Co-Edit）对照组，并在更长的任务上研究重复编辑及其相对时序安排 [ 30 ]。 SyncMind 利用仓库历史构建调用者/被调用者之间的不一致性，并评估自主式与协作式的恢复 [ 10 ]。 SWE-Shift 从同一份记录的历史中分叉出后续内容，并检查在一次授权更新之后仍然生效的需求。 即使移除某项更新仍能通过原始问题的测试，该更新也可能需要被保留。 表 7 从被操纵对象、历史控制和结果三个层面比较了这些设计。

paragraphs.en: SWE-INTERACT progressively reveals requirements through a workspace-aware user simulator and scores the submitted solution with the underlying task verifier [ 28 ] . SWE-Together reconstructs tasks from real user–agent sessions, combines agentic-judge correctness with corrective-turn diagnostics, and grounds the simulator in the original user’s intent [ 33 ] . SpecPath makes a complementary control explicit: vary the history while holding the final contract, repository, verifier, and execution policy fixed. Implementation begins only after the complete history is visible [ 32 ] . Its specification-history result and representation of active obligations are direct precedents for distinguishing retained from withdrawn requirements. SWE-Shift instead changes an already-started execution and its external state. Comparing these settings separates clarifying requirements before action from continuing work after a dependency or authority has changed.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-INTERACT 通过一个具备工作区感知能力的用户模拟器逐步揭示需求，并使用底层任务验证器对提交的解决方案进行评分 [ 28 ] 。 SWE-Together 从真实的用户—智能体会话中重建任务，将智能体评判的正确性与纠错轮次的诊断相结合，并将模拟器建立在原始用户意图的基础上 [ 33 ] 。 SpecPath 使一种互补的控制变得明确：在保持最终契约、代码仓库、验证器和执行策略不变的情况下，改变历史。 实现只有在完整历史可见之后才会开始 [ 32 ] 。 它的规范历史结果以及对活跃义务的表示，是区分保留需求与撤回需求的直接先例。 SWE-Shift 则改变的是已经开始的执行及其外部状态。 比较这两种设置，可以把在行动之前澄清需求，与在依赖或权限发生变化之后继续工作区分开来。

paragraphs.en: AppWorld already makes collateral damage part of task evaluation: expected and permitted database changes constrain the difference between initial and final states while admitting multiple solutions [ 31 ] . ToolSandbox checks ordered milestones and forbidden events across stateful tool trajectories [ 16 ] . τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench gives both user and agent control of the environment and supports state and interaction checks [ 3 ] . Gaia2 advances this setting to independently evolving, asynchronous events with action-level verification [ 8 ] ; FutureSim replays real information chronologically for forecasting agents [ 9 ] . These works show why successful action cannot be reduced to a plausible final answer. SWE-Shift specializes this concern to controlled repository continuations, where preserving another actor’s valid change and respecting an irreversible effect can require different recovery operations.
paragraphs.zh: AppWorld 已经将附带损害纳入任务评估：期望且允许的数据库变更约束初始状态与最终状态之间的差异，同时允许多种解法 [ 31 ]。 ToolSandbox 在有状态的工具轨迹上检查有序的里程碑和被禁止的事件 [ 16 ]。τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench 让用户和智能体都能控制环境，并支持状态与交互检查 [ 3 ]。 Gaia2 将这一设定推进到独立演化、异步的事件并附带动作级验证 [ 8 ]；FutureSim 按时间顺序回放真实信息以供预测型智能体使用 [ 9 ]。 这些工作表明，为什么成功的动作不能被简化为一个看似合理的最终答案。 SWE-Shift 将这一关注点专门用于受控的仓库延续场景，其中保留另一位参与者的有效变更以及尊重不可逆的影响，可能需要不同的恢复操作。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the initial 24-case set, which contains two cases per family and complete trajectory and evaluator records. Each case occupies one page, pairing the task, authorized change, and requirements that apply after the change with selected actions from the recorded GPT-5.6 Sol trajectory (Codex app, xhigh ) and independent evaluator checks. Step labels refer to the recorded trajectory; shaded monospace blocks show edit or tool-response excerpts, with selected response fields explicitly marked. The four-part result row reports Shifted task, recovery, preservation, and freshness; additional failed checks appear below it. Clean and Shifted denote success only when all applicable checks pass. Each card presents agent actions, self-reported test results, and independent evaluator findings separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了最初的 24 个案例集合，每个家族包含两个案例，并带有完整的轨迹和评估器记录。 每个案例占据一页，将任务、授权变更以及变更后适用的要求，与从记录的 GPT-5.6 Sol 轨迹（Codex 应用，xhigh）中选取的动作以及独立评估器检查配对呈现。 步骤标签对应记录的轨迹；带底色的等宽字体区块显示编辑或工具响应的摘录，其中被选取的响应字段已明确标出。 四部分的结果行报告 Shifted 下的任务、恢复、保持和新鲜度；其他未通过的检查显示在该行下方。 只有当所有适用的检查都通过时，Clean 和 Shifted 才表示成功。 每张卡片分别呈现智能体动作、智能体自报的测试结果以及独立评估器的发现。
